source.method: Static text/Babel AST; independently calculated data vectors. No require/import/eval of the OEM bundle or OEM function execution.
source.coordinates: Zero-based UTF-16 character offsets and UTF-8 byte offsets, all end-exclusive.

family_route.route: applyMouseMacro dispatch checks $D(device.productName), which tests X8 membership. NewMouse/Nordic branch calls $Ue -> HUe -> vbt/Qbt -> mu(0x090B) -> i1e(report ID0x4D).
family_route.old_route: The other branch uses aJ with older0x12/0x55 framing and a distinct body format; it must not supply V3 header/count/event semantics.
family_route.identity_limit: The historical physical3837:4026 identity and source catalog A7 V3 Ultra+4033 discrepancy is tracked by root. These shared NewMouse-family protocol facts do not authorize changing MODEL_PID or enabling another model.

fields.fact: Little-endian length in bytes of event body: event count times4.

56-byte name region: UTF-8 bytes, source writer truncates at56 bytes and pads zeroes.

mode2_limit: Localized label/description strings are not in this retained bundle. No numeric repeat count is sent by the V3 writer; this does not prove mode2 means a single run or N runs. Keep original-mode2 wording and do not invent count controls.

event.first_word: Bytes0..1 are little-endian val only for source type time. The source writer emits0,0 for key/mouse/mousescroll.
event.opcode: Byte2 bits0..5: key17,mouse0,mousescroll5,time63. Bit6 is1 iff press is down. Bit7 is1 iff this is the final event.
event.code: Byte3: keyboard usage from qM; mouse mask Left1,Middle4,Right2,Forward16,Back8; scroll Up0/Down1; time0.
event.inline_limit: Nonzero words on non-time records are not established timing semantics by this source. Existing read data must be retained as opaque bytes or edits explicitly refused; do not reinterpret or silently zero them.

commands.write: 0x090B; payload [slot,offset_lo,offset_hi,write_control,...part]; parts at most19 bytes; control=(part_length<<2)|flags, first1,middle0,last2. Macro has at least64 bytes, so first and last chunks are distinct. Source requests total packet length32.
commands.read: 0x090C name reader requests22 data bytes at offsets0,22,44, takes returned slice1..23, concatenates, extracts bytes8..63 and decodes UTF-8 until NUL, then trims for display. It does not prove a full event-body decoder.
commands.read_prefix_limit: This source drops the first returned byte; it does not explicitly label or validate that byte as length versus status.
commands.command090A: No StringLiteral or NumericLiteral0x090A and no explicit090A route found in the full AST. This is an evidence gap, not proof firmware lacks it.
commands.packet: Report ID0x4D, version byte1, flags1, payload length, little-endian command, bizCode/sequence, payload; XOR checksum over flags through payload.

implemented_bounded_design.raw_baseline: Carry optional original raw macro content through native read, unchanged save, macro-file export/import and write. This is content provenance, not a physical-mouse identity or a repeat-count schema.
implemented_bounded_design.unchanged: When requested name/mode/events still match the decoded baseline, preserve and write/export exact baseline bytes, including opaque header words, non-time words and terminal flags.
implemented_bounded_design.canonical: For a new or canonically edited macro, retain the independently implemented OEM canonical encoder and balanced-key checks. Reject non-delay delay_ms!=0 instead of silently discarding it.
implemented_bounded_design.opaque_edits: If a baseline contains unmodelled header/event words or flags and user changes its interpreted values, retain the source and explicitly refuse lossy editing. Do not invent semantics or normalize the opaque bytes.
implemented_bounded_design.UI: Retain four source mode values0/1/3/2 with mode2 qualified as original mode2. No repeat-count field or new inline-delay control.
implemented_bounded_design.validation: Six native default tests, five new UI groups and eight actual UI save/export requests replayed through production codec and native transport; no physical playback.
